name: Taser
material: A stun gun or a rewired battery pack.
description:
You jam a homemade stun gun into a creature within reach. Make a melee technique attack. On a hit it takes 1d8 lightning damage, and a living target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.
The damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8) and 17th level (4d8).

name: Drain Cleaner
description:
You splash a cup of caustic drain cleaner you keep in a squeeze bottle at a creature within range. It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.
The damage increases by 1d6 at 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6) and 17th level (4d6).

name: Flashlight Trick
description: You rig a light source (a flashlight, a phone screen, a lamp with a battery) on an object you touch. It sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for 20 feet more. At night, light draws the dead.

name: Jury-rig
material: Duct tape, wire or glue.
description: You fix a single break in an object you touch: a snapped bat handle, a torn strap, a dead flashlight's loose contact. The fix holds until it takes real abuse.

name: Molotov
material: A glass bottle, a gasoline can and a rag (all used up).
description: You light the rag and throw. Each creature in a 10-foot radius where the bottle breaks makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Flammable objects in the area catch fire. The burning dead keep walking for a while.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Flashbang
material: A pinch of black powder in a tin (used up).
description: A homemade flash-and-bang charge. Each creature in a 10-foot radius makes a Constitution saving throw; on a failure it is blinded until the end of its next turn. It is very loud.

name: Tripwire
material: Wire, string or fishing line.
description: You string a low wire across a doorway, hallway or gap up to 10 feet wide. The first creature that crosses it without spotting it (Wisdom (Perception) against your technique save DC) must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. Cans tied to the line rattle, so you hear it too.

name: Smoke Bomb
material: A bag of fertilizer and a lighter (the fertilizer is used up).
description: A cooked mix of fertilizer and sugar pours out thick white smoke. A 20-foot-radius area becomes heavily obscured. The dead lose sight of you; they can still hear you.

name: Toxic Mix
material: Bleach and ammonia (both used up).
description: You mix two cleaning products in a bucket and kick it over. Each creature in a 10-foot radius makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d8 poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The dead don't breathe and shrug it off; this is for the living.
higherLevel: When you use a level 3 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d8 for each slot level above 2.

name: Pipe Bomb
material: A steel pipe, black powder and a fuse (all used up).
description: You light the fuse and throw the pipe. Each creature in a 20-foot radius makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d6 piercing damage from shrapnel on a failure or half as much on a success. The blast is heard across town.
higherLevel: When you use a level 4 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d6 for each slot level above 3.

name: Thermite
material: A jar of thermite mix and a road flare to light it (both used up).
description: You pack thermite against a lock, a hinge, an engine block or a creature that's pinned in place, and light it. It burns through steel in seconds. A creature in contact makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d8 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
higherLevel: When you use a level 5 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d8 for each slot level above 4.

name: Fuel-Air Blast
material: Two gasoline cans and a road flare (all used up).
description: You open the cans in a closed space, wait for the fumes and throw the flare from a safe distance. Each creature in a 30-foot radius makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Windows for a block shatter.
higherLevel: When you use a level 6 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d6 for each slot level above 5.

name: Stabilize
description: You put pressure on the wound, clear the airway and keep them with you. A creature at 0 hit points that you touch becomes stable.

name: Bedside Manner
description: Your calm voice steadies someone. Once before the technique ends, the creature you touch can roll a d4 and add it to one ability check.

name: Syringe Jab
description:
You drive a needle or a scalpel into a soft spot. Make a melee technique attack. On a hit the target takes 1d8 piercing damage.
The damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8) and 17th level (4d8).

name: Field Dressing
material: A bandage (used up).
description: You clean, pack and wrap a wound. A creature you touch regains 1d8 + your technique ability modifier hit points. This has no effect on the dead.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Painkillers
material: A dose of painkillers (used up).
description: You get a pill into someone and the pain backs off. A creature you touch regains 1d4 + your technique ability modifier hit points.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1.

name: Sedative
material: A sedative syringe (used up).
description: You inject a living creature you touch. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute, until it takes damage or someone shakes it awake. The dead are unaffected.

name: Triage
description: One look tells you who is dying, who is faking and who is bitten. You learn the hit points, conditions and any visible bite of up to three creatures you can see within range, and each one at 0 hit points becomes stable.

name: Rally
description: You shout clear orders. Up to three creatures of your choice that can hear you add 1d4 to their attack rolls and saving throws until the technique ends.

name: Adrenaline Shot
material: An epinephrine auto-injector (used up).
description: You slam an adrenaline pen into someone's thigh. A creature you touch regains 2d8 + your technique ability modifier hit points and, if it was unconscious from dropping to 0 hit points, wakes up.
higherLevel: When you use a level 3 slot or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2.

name: Clean the Wound
material: Rubbing alcohol (used up).
description: You scrub out a dirty wound or treat a poisoning. One disease or the poisoned condition affecting a creature you touch ends. It does nothing for a bite from the dead.

name: Field Surgery
material: A medkit (used up).
description: Sutures, a splint and a steady hand. A creature you touch regains 4d8 + your technique ability modifier hit points.
higherLevel: When you use a level 4 slot or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3.

name: Chest Compressions
material: An epinephrine auto-injector (used up).
description: You start CPR on someone whose heart stopped in the last minute, from wounds and not from a bite. They come back with 1 hit point. Someone who died of a bite does not come back as themselves.

name: Mass Casualty Protocol
material: A medkit and three bandages (all used up).
description: You run the scene like an ER. Up to six creatures of your choice within range each regain 3d8 + your technique ability modifier hit points.
higherLevel: When you use a level 6 slot or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5.

name: Taunt
description:
You find exactly the words that get under someone's skin. A creature that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 psychic damage and have disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. The dead hear only noise: it draws them to you.
The damage increases by 1d4 at 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4) and 17th level (4d4).

name: Throw Your Voice
description: You make a sound (a voice, a cough, a knock) seem to come from a point within range. Wisdom (Insight) against your technique save DC sees through it. A good way to send the dead the wrong way.

name: Air Horn
material: An air horn or a car horn.
description: A deafening blast at point-blank range. Each creature in a 15-foot cube from you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure it takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away; on a success it takes half and isn't pushed. Everything within half a mile hears it.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Sweet Talk
description: You talk like their oldest friend. A living person who can understand you makes a Wisdom saving throw, with advantage if you or your friends are threatening it. On a failure it is charmed by you for 1 hour or until you or your companions harm it. When it ends, it knows it was played.

name: Keep Breathing
description: "Stay with me. In, out. You've got this." A creature that can hear you regains 1d4 + your technique ability modifier hit points as it pushes through the pain.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1.

name: Lull
description: Your late-night radio voice. Roll 5d8: that many hit points of tired, living creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose fall asleep, weakest first, until they take damage or someone wakes them. The dead never sleep.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, roll an extra 2d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Radio Silence
description: You get the group moving like a single quiet thing: hand signals, timing, where to step. You and up to five companions within 30 feet gain +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks while the technique lasts.

name: Feedback Squeal
material: Batteries for a speaker or bullhorn (used up).
description: You point a bullhorn at a speaker and let it howl. Each creature in a 10-foot radius makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d8 thunder damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Every dead thing nearby turns toward the sound.
higherLevel: When you use a level 3 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d8 for each slot level above 2.

name: Decoy Broadcast
material: A radio or speaker you leave behind, and two batteries (the batteries are used up).
description: You set a radio to play loud, on a timer, somewhere you're about to leave. For the next hour the dead within a few hundred feet drift toward it instead of you.

name: Spread Panic
description: You yell the thing everyone's afraid of: "They're inside! RUN!" Each living creature in a 30-foot cone makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it is frightened of you and drops what it is holding to flee. It repeats the save when it ends its turn out of your sight.

name: Talk Down
description: You talk an armed, frightened person out of it. A living humanoid that can understand you makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it is paralyzed with indecision. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, and the effect ends if it is attacked.

name: Hay Hook
material: A hay hook or a length of chain.
description:
You swing a hay hook at a creature within 10 feet. Make a melee technique attack. On a hit it takes 1d6 piercing damage, and you can pull a Large or smaller creature up to 10 feet toward you.
The damage increases by 1d6 at 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6) and 17th level (4d6).

name: Snare
material: A coil of snare wire (used up).
description: You've laid loops of wire through the tall grass or the rubble. A 20-foot square becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your technique save DC to tear free.

name: Preserves
description: You put up what you've foraged: jerky, pickled roots, berries in syrup. You make up to ten portions. Eating one takes an action, restores 1 hit point, and is a day's food. They spoil in 24 hours.

name: Herbal Remedy
description: A poultice of yarrow and plantain, the kind your grandmother used. A creature you touch regains 1d6 + your technique ability modifier hit points.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, the healing increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Animal Whisperer
description: Low voice, no sudden moves, food held out flat. An animal that can see you makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it is charmed by you for 24 hours and won't attack you. Starving or rabid animals have advantage on the save.

name: Hay Smoke
material: Matches (used up) and wet hay or brush.
description: You light damp hay and it pours out acrid smoke. A 20-foot-radius area is heavily obscured. Each living creature in it when it starts must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned (coughing, eyes streaming) while it stays inside.

name: Camouflage
description: Mud, leaves, a burlap tarp, stillness. You and up to five companions within 30 feet gain +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can't be tracked except by unusual means.

name: Stampede
description: You open the gate and drive the livestock (there must be cattle or horses nearby). Each creature in a 60-foot line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d10 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
higherLevel: When you use a level 4 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d10 for each slot level above 3.

name: Controlled Burn
material: A gasoline can and matches (both used up).
description: You know which way the wind blows across a field. You light a line of fuel and the fire sweeps a 20-foot radius: each creature there makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
higherLevel: When you use a level 5 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d6 for each slot level above 4.

name: Kick the Hive
description: You know where the apiary is and how to make the bees angry (there must be hives nearby). A furious swarm fills a 20-foot radius: each living creature there makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The dead don't notice the stings.
higherLevel: When you use a level 6 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d10 for each slot level above 5.

name: Mark Target
description: You pick one creature you can see and read how it moves. Until the technique ends you deal an extra 1d6 damage when you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find it.

name: Tin-can Alarm
material: String and a few empty cans.
description: You ring a door, a window or an area up to a 20-foot cube with string and cans. Until the technique ends, you hear it when anything Tiny or bigger touches or crosses the line, and it wakes you. You can set it up as a ritual in 10 minutes without spending a slot.

name: Spike Trap
material: A box of nails (used up).
description: You scatter nailed boards where they'll be stepped on. Each creature in a 20-foot radius takes 2d4 piercing damage, and the area is difficult terrain until cleared.
higherLevel: When you use a level 3 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d4 for each slot level above 2.

name: Rapid Fire
material: A bow and three arrows (the arrows are used up).
description: You nock and loose three arrows in the time it takes to draw one. Each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Quiet.
higherLevel: When you use a level 4 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d8 for each slot level above 3.

name: Deadfall
description: You cut the rope on a rigged log, an engine block on a chain or a stack of pallets. Each creature in a 10-foot cube makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
higherLevel: When you use a level 5 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d10 for each slot level above 4.

name: Cuff Them
material: Handcuffs or zip ties.
description: You snap cuffs on a creature within reach, or on it and a railing. It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until it is freed (a key, or a DC 20 Strength check to break the chain). The dead pull until they tear their own hands off.

name: Freeze!
description: "POLICE! FREEZE! DROP IT!" A living creature that can hear and understand you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or obey a one-word command on its next turn (freeze, drop, down, back). The dead don't follow orders.

name: Flashlight Glare
material: A flashlight.
description: You put a tactical flashlight beam right in their eyes. A creature within range that can see must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn. Works on the dead, too.

name: Riot Shield Stance
description: You plant your feet and brace behind your shield or a car door. You gain a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Pepper Spray
material: A burst of pepper spray (used up).
description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure it takes 2d6 poison damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn; on a success it takes half and isn't blinded. The dead are immune to the burn.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

name: Suppressing Fire
material: A pistol and five 9mm rounds (the rounds are used up).
description: You empty part of a magazine to make everyone duck. Each creature in a 30-foot cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Very loud.
higherLevel: When you use a level 3 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d10 for each slot level above 2.

name: Hurled Brick
description:
You throw a brick, a rock or a can of beans like a fastball. Make a ranged technique attack. On a hit the target takes 1d10 bludgeoning damage. There's always something to throw.
The damage increases by 1d10 at 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10) and 17th level (4d10).

name: Tackle
description:
You hit a creature within reach at full speed. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 1d6 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.
The damage increases by 1d6 at 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6) and 17th level (4d6).

name: Uppercut
description:
Trained hands. Make a melee technique attack against a creature within reach. On a hit it takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage.
The damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8) and 17th level (4d8).

name: Sprint
description: You run like the race of your life. When you use this, and as a bonus action on each of your turns until it ends, you can take the Dash action.

name: Parkour Leap
description: Walls, car roofs, dumpsters: everything is a step. For 1 minute your jump distance is tripled and climbing doesn't cost you extra movement.

name: Roll Landing
description: Reaction when you fall. You tuck and roll: you take no falling damage from up to 60 feet and land on your feet.

name: Block
description: Reaction when you are hit by an attack. You get an arm, a bag or a car door in the way: until the start of your next turn you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack.

name: Grit Your Teeth
description: You've played hurt before. You gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for 1 hour.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, you gain 5 more temporary hit points for each slot level above 1.

name: Spin Move
description: You slip between grasping hands. You move up to 30 feet to a space you can see, and this movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Brick Barrage
description: A rapid volley of whatever is to hand. Make a ranged technique attack against a creature within range. On a hit it takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage.
higherLevel: When you use a level 3 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d6 for each slot level above 2.

name: Second Gear
description: You find the gear you only hit in championship games. Your speed doubles, you gain +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and one extra action each turn (Attack with one weapon, Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object). When it ends you can't move or act until after your next turn.

name: Bowl Them Over
description: You charge straight through them. Each creature in a 30-foot line makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure it takes 4d8 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone; on a success it takes half and stays up.
higherLevel: When you use a level 4 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d8 for each slot level above 3.

name: Shiv Flurry
description:
Fast, ugly stabs you learned in the yard. Make a melee technique attack against a creature within reach. On a hit it takes 1d10 piercing damage.
The damage increases by 1d10 at 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10) and 17th level (4d10).

name: Mad Dog Stare
description: You look at someone like you've already decided. A living creature that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of its next turn. The dead don't scare.

name: Shank
description: One committed stab to the kidney or the base of the skull. Make a melee technique attack against a creature within reach. On a hit it takes 3d8 piercing damage.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Payback
description: Reaction when a creature you can see damages you. You hit back hard before it can recover: it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 slashing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
higherLevel: When you use a level 2 slot or higher, it deals an extra 1d10 for each slot level above 1.

name: Prison Tricks
material: A bent paperclip, a shim or a credit card.
description: You open one ordinary lock, latch, padlock, handcuff or zip tie you touch, in seconds. It makes a small click, nothing more.

name: Disappear
description: Hood up, head down, walk like you belong. Among other people, in a crowd or in the chaos of a fight, you are effectively invisible to anyone not already looking at you, until you attack or draw attention.
